answer: Honeypot canaries resist sybil graders: the system seeds a terrace of planted answers whose true quality is known only to the auditor, some deliberately flawed, indistinguishable from real submissions. A diligent honest grader scores the flawed pearl low; a colluding or rubber-stamping ring that waves everything through lights up violet the instant it passes a honeypot. Because graders cannot tell canaries from genuine work, they cannot selectively behave, so detection on a lazy or coordinated grader approaches one over enough plants. Flagged graders lose standing.
